## Services

- Domestic cleaning: weekly, fortnightly or one-off home cleans. Products and a hoover supplied.
- End of tenancy cleaning: a deep clean of all areas, ideal for getting a deposit back or preparing for new tenants.
- Commercial and office cleaning: offices and retail spaces, including after-hours cleaning to minimise disruption.
- Builders and sparkle cleans: clearing dust after building work or renovation.
- Industrial cleans: get in touch to discuss requirements.
- Personalised cleaning plans: flexible schedules built around the client.

## Why clients choose them

- A friendly, trustworthy and reliable established local team based in Ashford, Kent.
- All products and a hoover supplied; high end products used. Clients are asked to provide a mop if one is needed, for hygiene reasons.
- Finishing touches such as rolled towels and a paper bow on the toilet roll.

- What areas do you cover? Homes and businesses in Ashford, Kent and the surrounding areas. If unsure, call or message.

- Do you do end of tenancy cleaning in Ashford? Yes, a deep clean of all areas.
- Do you clean offices? Yes, including after-hours cleaning.
